posts.t:
Final- Lightning 6, Golden Knights 2

The chances felt fairly even tonight, with both teams creating plenty. 

Andrei Vasilevskiy was the difference. He was brilliant, as he often is.
Trevor Connelly is the driver of the Golden Knights' third line. No question.
William Karlsson was slow to get back to the bench after hitting the boards on that last shift. The trainer talked to him, but he's staying on the bench for now.

Brutal turnover by Eichel, and Cirelli buries it top shelf before you can blink. 

4-2 Lightning

Mark Stone, all by his lonesome on the backside of the play, and he snipes one by Vasilevskiy short side. 

2-2

Ivan Barbashev has done it. 

He ties it 1-1 with his first goal of the season. A rebound in front after Vasievskiy robbed Marner. 

A brutal turnover started it all after a TB defender's stick snapped in half.
Karlsson walks down the left wing, Vasilevskiy came way out and snagged it with the glove.
Carter Hart is the first goalie off the ice, starting tonight for Vegas

Final- Golden Knights 6, Penguins 2

Vegas continues to take care of bad hockey teams with relative ease. They've been a machine through 10 games.

Shea Theodore gets in on the fun. 

5-1 Vegas

Three goals from defensemen now

Trevor Connelly answers with a spectacular goal to make it 4-1. 

He leaned into the defender, pulled the puck in to change the shooting angle, and ripped it by Murashov.
The Penguins have actually looked ok with the puck, but defensively they've been a complete mess, and the Golden Knights have eaten them alive.

Another wide open defenseman on the backside of the play. 

Another goal. 

This time it was Noah Hanifin. 

2-0 Vegas
Rasmus Andersson dives into the offensive zone, and buries the first shot of the game to give Vegas a 1-0 lead.

Adin Hill is the first goalie off the ice.

He starts tonight for Vegas
